name: tcw
description: Taxonomy · Capabilities · Work — a storage-abstracted framework for describing and evolving a software project.

interface.shortDescription: Skills for the tcw workflow: taxonomy, capabilities, work tracking, and documentation sync.
interface.longDescription: tcw (Taxonomy · Capabilities · Work) is a storage-abstracted framework for describing and evolving a software project along three axes. This plugin ships fourteen skills — the three axis drivers tcw-taxonomy, tcw-capabilities, and tcw-work; tcw-work-stage, which hands you a lifecycle stage's working document and the instructions your project resolves for it as one read, plus one skill per stage that bakes the stage in and asks only for the work item — tcw-work-stage-request, tcw-work-stage-spec, tcw-work-stage-plan, tcw-work-stage-implement, and tcw-work-stage-verify; tcw-plugin for installing and repairing the CLI; tcw-report for filing bugs and suggestions upstream; tcw-triage-issues for turning your own project's GitHub issues into tracked work; tcw-post-mortem for finding which lifecycle stage could first have caught a problem; and documentation-sync, a cross-cutting process skill that keeps docs in step with code — driving the tcw workflow from inside an AI coding agent.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me use tcw to plan and track work.
